document:2:182:0.text:
Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Dashroot Powder</style>
<style="highlight">Baby Mushrooms</style>
<style="highlight">Fresh Dew</style>
Mash the baby fuzzy mushrooms to extract the juice, then add fine dashroot powder and fresh dew. Simmer the mixture until small bubbles start to form on the surface.
document:2:182:0.source_cn:
配料：
<style="highlight">疾根草粉末</style>
<style="highlight">稚嫩的茸茸伞菇</style>
<style="highlight">新鲜的露水</style>
将稚嫩的茸茸伞菇捣成汁液，加入研磨极细的疾根草粉末，再加入新鲜露水熬煮至表面冒出细小泡沫。
